post.summary: Lists all available customer tags for a company.
post.description:
Customer tags help categorize clients and can be used for marketing,
reporting, and service customization. Tags can indicate preferences,
loyalty status, or special handling requirements.

Returns all active tags for the specified company.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
ID of the company to list customer tags for
Required. Must be a valid company ID

post.summary: Lists all available pet codes for a company.
post.description:
Pet codes are used to flag special handling requirements or medical conditions
that staff need to be aware of when providing services. These codes are
displayed prominently in pet profiles and during service delivery.

Returns all active codes for the specified company.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
ID of the company to list pet codes for
Required. Must be a valid company ID

post.description:
Adds a new service definition to the system. The service must be associated with
a specific company and can optionally belong to one or more business locations.

Returns the created service with assigned ID.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.
Returns ALREADY_EXISTS if a service with the same ID already exists.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
ID of the company to create the service under.
Required. Must be a valid company ID.

get.summary: Gets the details of a specific service.
get.description:
Retrieves detailed information about a service identified by its ID.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the service does not exist.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
ID of the company that owns the service.
Required. Must be a valid company ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
ID of the service to retrieve.
Required. Must be a valid service ID.

put.description:
Modifies the details of an existing service. The update may affect all business
locations where this service is used.

Returns the updated service.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.
Returns NOT_FOUND if the service does not exist.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
ID of the company that owns the service.
Required. Must be a valid company ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the service to update.
Required. Must be a valid service ID.

post.summary: Lists available services based on specified criteria.
post.description:
Services can be filtered by business location and service type.
Results are paginated and can be used for service menu display,
appointment booking, and pricing calculations.

Returns services matching the filter criteria.
Returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description:
ID of the company to list services for
Required. Must be a valid company ID

Tag represents a label that can be applied to customers for categorization
and filtering purposes.

PetCode.title:

ServiceItemType.description:
ItemType categorizes the primary type of service being offered.
This helps organize services in the system and determines applicable business rules.

 - SERVICE_ITEM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified service type
Should not be used when creating new services
 - GROOMING: Pet grooming services
Includes bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, etc.
 - BOARDING: Pet boarding services
Overnight or extended stay care
 - DAYCARE: Daytime pet care services
Supervised play and care during business hours
 - EVALUATION: Pet evaluation services
Behavior assessment and service compatibility check
 - TRAINING: Pet training services
Individual or group training sessions

settingv1Service.description:
Service represents a specific service or add-on that can be provided to pets.
Services are the core offerings of your business and can be customized based on
location, staff availability, and service type. Each service has its own pricing,
duration, and availability settings.

currencyCode.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

units.description:
The whole units of the amount.
For example if `currencyCode` is `"USD"`, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

nanos.description:
Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount.
The value must be between -999,999,999 and +999,999,999 inclusive.
If `units` is positive, `nanos` must be positive or zero.
If `units` is zero, `nanos` can be positive, zero, or negative.
If `units` is negative, `nanos` must be negative or zero.
For example $-1.75 is represented as `units`=-1 and `nanos`=-750,000,000.

typeMoney.description: Represents an amount of money with its currency type.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

v1ServiceType.description:
Type indicates whether this is a standalone service or an add-on
that can be combined with other services.

 - SERVICE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified type
Should not be used when creating new services
 - SERVICE: Primary standalone service
Can be booked independently
 - ADDON: Additional service that complements primary services
Must be booked with a primary service
